text:
incident-bot: Pager duty alert: SEV2 - multiple containers in gpu-pool-7 entering CrashLoopBackOff (segfault). Pattern: runtime/engine (vLLM) processes SIGSEGV during model load. Node node-07 showing increased OOM/killing churn. https://internal.incidents/5987654321 :pager:

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'm on it. Paging eng-runtime-lead and ml-oncall.

eng-runtime-lead: On call, joining. Any customer-facing impact yet?

cs-rep: Getting multiple 500s reported from 12 customers, especially low-latency endpoints. Error rates spiked 8x in the last 6m. Some requests queued ~30s then dropped.

ml-oncall: Seeing GPU driver logs show "CUDA ERROR: illegal memory access" + segfault in fused_attention.so. Could be the new fused kernel build rolled yesterday.

alice: Confirmed: pods on node-07 (gpu-pool-7) crashloop with: 
```
SIGSEGV: address=0x7f8ab00c tid=1
#0  0x7f8ab00c in fused_attn_forward(void*, int) at fused_attention.cu:412
#1  0x55aa9d7b in runtime::run_model()+0x2f
#2  0x55aa9f1c in main_thread()+0x4b
```
Looks like nvcc compiled fused op hitting an invalid pointer.

devon: Starting node isolation to stop blast radius. Plan: cordon node-07, drain pods to other GPU nodes. Any objections?

eng-runtime-lead: +1. Also set cluster env override to disable fused kernels for new pods: REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 (hot env toggle). That should prevent new pods from using the fused op.

sre-oncall: Executing drain now. `kubectl cordon node-07; kubectl drain node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

incident-bot: Deploy hook: drain started by sre-oncall at 5987654340.

deploy-bot: Rolling back runtime image in default/gpu-runtime deployment from v1.5.0 to v1.4.2 (previous stable). Rollout initiation: 5987654350.

ml-oncall: Noted that some pods that already have cached KV may still attempt fused op on restart. Recommend immediate restart of affected deployments after env toggle applied.

alice: Applied REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 at deployment level and restarted 6 pods. Crash loops stopped on restarted pods, monitoring other nodes.

cs-rep: Customer impact reduced. Error rate down to 1.3x baseline. CS opened incident emails to the 12 affected accounts.

eng-runtime-lead: Collecting core dumps for one sample for triage (saved to s3://incidents/5987654321/cores). Asking build team to bisect the fused kernel change landed in v1.5.0.

devon: Node-07 still under investigation. Keeping it cordoned until we validate kernel rollback.

sre-oncall: Handoff: devon will continue remediation, I'm moving to monitoring. devon, you're primary.

devon: Acknowledged, taking over. Will coordinate hotfix PR + safe rollout.

eng-runtime-lead: Early root cause hypothesis: corrupted device pointer from new memory pooling optimization in fused_attention.cu interacting badly with specific sequence lengths. Workaround: disable fused kernels + rollback image. Permanent fix assigned to eng-runtime.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated (customer errors reduced, crashloops stopped). Postmortem requested. Assigning to eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: rollout status: success. All updated pods stabilized.

cs-rep: I'll send an interim customer update. We should include ETA for permanent fix in postmortem.

eng-runtime-lead: Postmortem assignee: cheng. Slack follow-up thread: run a bisect, add unit test for the pooling case, and add e2e that exercises long sequence lengths.

devon: Logging follow-up: add metric alert for kernel-SIGSEGV patterns and automated env toggle.

sre-oncall: Closing pager. If any regressions appear, reopen. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:
